name: Clean-slate roundtable (no prior strategy)
goal: The overriding goal is higher AUROC on UNSEEN accounts; treat any overfitting to training data, validation folds or leaderboard feedback as a defect.
task: Design, from scratch, the most accurate model for this competition that generalises to unseen accounts, grounding choices in the course lectures (cite as W# sN). Cover cleaning, feature engineering, model choice (ensembles welcome), leakage-free selection/tuning and validation.
risk_focus: overfitting, leakage, members that are too correlated to help, weights tuned on the scored folds
final_instructions: Finalise the ensemble architecture exactly: members, features, hyperparameters (fixed or tuned only in inner CV), aggregation rule, validation protocol and anti-overfitting measures.
readme_extra: METRICS.json was computed by the operator; lockbox AUROC (1,389 accounts, 66 positives) was hidden from competitors. Differences below ~0.01 are noise.

execute.contract: EXECUTION CONTRACT: the operator runs your script once. DATA_DIR train.csv EXCLUDES the hidden lockbox; DATA_DIR test.csv holds the lockbox IDs. Read os.environ['DATA_DIR']; write ONLY inside os.environ['OUT_DIR']. Write all code yourself (no project modules are provided). Python 3.14, CPU only (8 cores), 25-minute limit; libraries: numpy, pandas 3, scipy, scikit-learn 1.9 (has RandomForest, ExtraTrees, AdaBoost, GradientBoosting, HistGradientBoosting, Bagging, Voting/Stacking), torch 2.13 CPU, pyarrow, threadpoolctl. No installs, network or subprocess. Set seeds. Required outputs in OUT_DIR: results.json {"models": {name: {"cv_auroc": float, "notes": str}}, "best": name, "validation": str}; oof_final.csv (account.id,pred) for EVERY train.csv account; submission.csv (ID,Predicted) for every test.csv ID; diagnostics.json (train vs CV AUROC, fold spread, member correlations, chosen weights).
